captions.detailed: A compact, squat manual air fryer featuring a dark matte finish rounded body with a pullout basket drawer. The top cap holds two rotating black dials for temperature and timer adjustments, alongside a small, red, prismatic push-button power switch. The front drawer slides out smoothly on a prismatic joint, revealing a thin-walled hollow cooking cavity with a perforated inner basket. A small red release button is integrated into the handle, moving prismatically to unlock the basket.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact manual air fryer with a dark rounded body, a pullout basket drawer, a perforated inner cooking basket, and a top control cap. The top cap should feature two rotating dials (temperature and timer) and a small red push button, while the front drawer handle should include a functional red release button.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a rounded box primitive, then hollow it out to create the cooking cavity. Model the top cap as a smaller rounded block on top of the main body, and add two conical dials (revolute joints) and a small cylinder for the power button (prismatic joint). Build the drawer assembly with a front panel, a thin-walled inner basket with perforated patterns, and an attached handle featuring a small nested red button (prismatic joint). Finally, define a prismatic joint for the entire drawer assembly relative to the main body.
